title: Daily rollup and one place alerts arrive
description:
**Phase 2 of 7.**

- **Blocked by:** the budgets construct and the vendor ledger
- **Runs in parallel with:** nothing
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
No always-on aggregator; that reintroduces the idle floor the architecture avoids. EventBridge Scheduler already wakes a Lambda for turn deadlines, and a daily rollup is the same shape: a routine wake-up, not something in the token path, which is what docs/STACK.md permits.

Daily, read Cost Explorer for the AWS side and the ledger for the vendor side, write one rollup row per day per organization and per environment, publish to SNS on a threshold crossing.

AWS Budgets fires its own native alerts on its own schedule. Send them to the same topic and record in the rollup that an alert fired, so a human sees one sequence of events instead of two disconnected emails whose relationship they must reconstruct.
